28521.description:
Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.


Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.


Purpose
As an Oxygen Plant Technician, you will play a critical role in ensuring the safe and efficient operation of the oxygen process plant, supporting overall production performance and plant reliability. Your contribution will directly impact safety outcomes, operational continuity, and equipment performance through disciplined plant operation, inspections, and compliance with HSE standards.
You will support daily operations by monitoring plant systems, identifying defects, and maintaining high standards of process control, reliability, and safety, while contributing to a strong team culture and continuous improvement.


Essential Duties




Operate and monitor oxygen plant equipment in line with daily plans and supervisor direction


Ensure full compliance with HSE policies, procedures, and Fitness for Work requirements


Perform routine plant inspections, system checks, and defect identification


Report hazards, defects, and maintenance requirements through appropriate systems


Follow safe work procedures and standard operating processes (SOPs) at all times


Support shift activities including handover, toolbox meetings, and skills training

Senior Fleet & Asset Administrator


 


HBS PNG LIMITED currently operates in numerous mine sites across PNG, both on the mainland and remote island locations. We own and operate one of the largest and best maintained mining fleets in PNG, offering the mining sector a variety of services including road construction, maintenance, haulage, lighting, crushing services and plant equipment hire.

to be based in Lae, Morobe Province
.
 Applicants must have experience within the mining and construction fields.

Asset Registry management for all site (Stock taking, Status, Movement Mob and De-Mob)

Coordinate Equipment Dealership (Customer Quote, Inventory, Invoicing, etc) by preparing regular reports on asset purchases, transfers, disposals, and deliveries.


Maintain audit-ready documentation for all fleet and equipment assets.

Minimum of at least 5 years’ experience in Fleet, Asset, Logistics, or Equipment Administration.


Strong background dealing with equipment suppliers, dealerships, and maintenance vendors.


Willingness to travel and work on-site as required


Mining industry experience with CMMS systems (SAP, PRONTO, D365, Fleetmate) highly regarded

28514.description:
Information Communications & Technology Officer – GIS & Remote Sensing (ICT–GIS/RS)


Papua New Guinea University of Natural Resources and Environment (PNGUNRE)


About the University


The Papua New Guinea University of Natural Resources and Environment (PNGUNRE) is a specialised national institution mandated to advance education, research, innovation, and community engagement in sustainable agriculture, natural resource management, environmental stewardship, and applied development disciplines.


PNGUNRE operates across four locations:




Vudal Main Campus (East New Britain Province) – home to the University's core teaching, research and administrative functions.


Takubar Campus (Kokopo, East New Britain Province) – host of Postgraduate Programs and the Department of Business & Economics.


Popondetta Campus (Oro Province) – focused on agricultural training, applied learning and community development initiatives.


Momis Ocean and Climate Research Institute (MOCRI), Rabaul (East New Britain Province) – PNGUNRE's specialist hub for ocean and climate research, environmental monitoring, climate resilience, sustainable development, and national and international research collaboration.




The University emphasises practice-oriented teaching, field-based learning, applied research, and strong partnerships with government, industry, communities and international institutions. Through its teaching, research and outreach activities, PNGUNRE develops graduates, knowledge and practical solutions that contribute to sustainable development in Papua New Guinea and the wider Pacific region.


About the Role


PNGUNRE invites applications from suitably qualified and experienced candidates for appointment as 
Information Communications & Technology Officer – GIS & Remote Sensing (ICT–GIS/RS)
 within the 
Momis Ocean and Climate Research Institute (MOCRI)
, based in Rabaul, East New Britain Province.


This is a Lecturer I-level position combining academic teaching, applied research and specialist technical responsibilities in Information and Communications Technology (ICT), Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Remote Sensing (RS), spatial data management and digital technologies.


The successful appointee will contribute to teaching at undergraduate and postgraduate levels, particularly in ICT, GIS, remote sensing and related areas. The incumbent will also support research and field-based activities by applying geospatial and digital technologies to ocean, climate, atmospheric, coastal, land and environmental studies.


In addition to academic responsibilities, the position will provide specialist oversight and support for MOCRI's ICT systems, GIS/RS applications, research databases, computer networks, e-learning platforms and other digital infrastructure required for teaching and research.


The position reports directly to the Dean – Momis Ocean and Climate Research Institute (MOCRI) and will work collaboratively with academics, researchers and technical staff across the Institute and University.


Key Responsibilities




Teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses in ICT, GIS, remote sensing, spatial data analysis and related areas.


Prepare and deliver lectures, tutorials, laboratory practicals, field exercises and assessments.


Contribute to curriculum development and review and prepare relevant teaching and e-learning materials.


Support and supervise undergraduate and postgraduate student research involving ICT, GIS, remote sensing and spatial analysis.


Undertake applied research and contribute to multidisciplinary research in ocean, climate, atmospheric, coastal, land and environmental sciences.


Apply GIS and remote sensing technologies to environmental monitoring, mapping, spatial modelling, resource assessment and research.


Assist researchers and students with spatial data collection, management, analysis, interpretation, visualisation and presentation.


Contribute to scholarly publications, research seminars, conferences and collaborative research activities.


Assist in developing research proposals and participate in externally funded research and consultancy projects.


Provide specialist oversight and support for MOCRI's computer systems, networks, software, GIS/RS platforms and related digital research infrastructure.


Ensure computer systems and networks are secure, functional and appropriately maintained for academic and research use.


Support the development and administration of research databases and digital information systems.


Support e-learning platforms and technology-enabled delivery of undergraduate, postgraduate and short-course programs.


Work collaboratively with academics and researchers across PNGUNRE on multidisciplinary research and teaching activities.


Assist in organising and supervising student field trips, practical activities and research requiring GIS/RS and ICT applications.


Contribute technical and academic expertise to collaborative projects involving government agencies, communities, industry and research institutions.


Participate in MOCRI and University academic governance, seminars, quality assurance and administrative activities.


Maintain appropriate documentation, inventories and records relating to ICT and GIS/RS resources.




Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Experience


Applicants should demonstrate:




A Master's degree in Information and Communications Technology, Information Technology, Computer Science, Geographic Information Systems, Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics, Spatial Science, or a closely related discipline.


A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years of relevant professional, teaching and/or research experience, preferably within a university, research institution, government agency or relevant professional environment.


Demonstrated knowledge and practical experience in GIS and remote sensing technologies, spatial data analysis and their application to environmental, ocean, climate or natural resource research.


Demonstrated competency in computer networking, systems administration, programming, database management and ICT support.


Ability to teach and provide practical instruction in ICT, GIS, remote sensing and related digital technologies.


Demonstrated capacity to support undergraduate and postgraduate student research.


Ability to collect, manage, analyse, interpret and present spatial and research data.


Experience with GIS/RS software and geospatial data platforms used for mapping, spatial analysis and environmental monitoring.


Knowledge of e-learning platforms and technology-supported teaching and learning.


Demonstrated research capability and an interest in developing scholarly publications in ICT, GIS/RS or related applied research areas.


Ability to participate effectively in multidisciplinary research and externally funded projects.


Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and project management skills.


Ability to work effectively with academics, researchers, students, government agencies, communities and external research partners.


Understanding of Papua New Guinea's environmental, natural resource and sustainable development context.


High standards of academic integrity, professionalism and responsible management of University ICT and research resources.




Teaching & Technical Focus


PNGUNRE is particularly interested in candidates with expertise in several of the following areas:




Geographic Information Systems (GIS)


Remote sensing and earth observation


Spatial data analysis and modelling


Computer programming and database management


Computer networks and systems administration


Spatial mapping and visualisation


Environmental and natural resource information systems


Ocean, climate and atmospheric data applications


Geospatial applications for coastal and marine research


Digital research data management


ICT-supported environmental monitoring


E-learning and online teaching technologies




Salary Range


Lecturer I / II


Lecturer I: K51,328.00 – K62,733.00
Lecturer II: K56,165.00 – K68,647.00


(plus applicable allowances and benefits)


 


 


 


Why Join PNGUNRE?


This position provides an opportunity to combine academic teaching with ICT, GIS and remote sensing expertise in a research environment addressing practical ocean, climate and environmental challenges.


Working within the Momis Ocean and Climate Research Institute, the successful candidate will contribute directly to teaching and student development while helping build the Institute's geospatial, digital and research capability.


The role is particularly suited to an ICT or geospatial professional seeking to apply their expertise beyond conventional IT support—using GIS, remote sensing and digital technologies in teaching, research, environmental monitoring and sustainable development in Papua New Guinea.


Application Details


Interested applicants should submit:




A cover letter addressing suitability, teaching capability and relevant technical/research experience for the position


A detailed Curriculum Vitae


Certified copies of academic and professional qualifications


Names and contact details of three (3) referees




Applications must be addressed to:


The Manager – Human Resources
Papua New Guinea University of Natural Resources and Environment
Vudal Campus, East New Britain Province
Email: 
[email protected]


Closing Date: Friday, 25 September 2026


PNGUNRE is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from suitably qualified candidates.


 








Apply

The role requires a highly organised and professional individual who can exercise sound judgement, manage competing priorities and confidential information, and ensure that matters requiring the Dean's attention are properly coordinated and followed through.


The position reports directly to the Dean – Momis Ocean and Climate Research Institute (MOCRI).


 


Key Responsibilities




Provide high-level executive and administrative support to the Dean in the day-to-day management of the Institute.


Manage the Dean's diary, appointments, meetings, official engagements and travel schedule.


Coordinate correspondence for the Dean's Office, including drafting and preparing letters, reports, briefing notes, presentations and other official documents.


Screen and prioritise correspondence, enquiries and matters requiring the Dean's attention and ensure appropriate follow-up.


Organise meetings chaired or attended by the Dean, including preparation of agendas, meeting papers, minutes and action points.


Maintain a system for monitoring decisions, commitments and action items arising from meetings and follow up with responsible officers where required.


Serve as a key administrative liaison between the Dean's Office and PNGUNRE management, schools, divisions and administrative units.


Coordinate communication and engagements between MOCRI and government agencies, research institutions, development partners, private sector organisations and other external stakeholders.


Assist the Dean with the administrative coordination of research partnerships, projects, workshops, conferences and official visits.


Coordinate travel, accommodation, meetings and logistical arrangements for the Dean, visiting researchers, collaborators and official guests.


Provide administrative support for postgraduate programs, research activities, student fieldwork, seminars and other Institute activities.


Maintain confidential executive records, correspondence, agreements and other documentation relating to the Dean's Office and MOCRI.


Assist in preparing information required for management reports, planning, budgeting, research activities and University governance processes.


Coordinate administrative arrangements for MOCRI seminars, workshops, short courses, outreach activities and stakeholder meetings.


Work closely with academic, technical, ICT and GIS/RS staff to facilitate the smooth administration of Institute activities.


Assist with procurement requests, office supplies, asset records and other operational requirements of the Dean's Office.


Represent the Dean's Office professionally when dealing with staff, students, visitors and external stakeholders.


Undertake other executive and administrative responsibilities as directed by the Dean.




 


Qualifications, Experience, Skills & Experience


Applicants should demonstrate:




Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resource Management, Public Administration, or a closely related discipline.


A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years of relevant executive, administrative or secretarial experience, preferably supporting senior management in a university, government, research institution or professional organisation.


Demonstrated ability to provide executive support to a senior manager, including diary management, meeting coordination, correspondence and follow-up of management decisions.


Strong computer literacy and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, email, internet and electronic records management.


Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritise work and manage several matters simultaneously.


Strong written communication skills with the ability to prepare professional correspondence, reports, minutes, briefing notes and presentations.


Sound records management and document-control skills, particularly in handling sensitive and confidential information.


Ability to organise executive meetings, official travel, workshops, conferences and stakeholder engagements.


Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate confidently and professionally with senior University officers, academics, government officials, researchers and external partners.


Ability to exercise initiative, discretion and sound judgement with minimal supervision.


Demonstrated ability to follow matters through and ensure agreed actions and deadlines are attended to.


High standards of integrity, confidentiality and professional conduct.


Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary and research-oriented environment.


An understanding of Papua New Guinea's university, government, research or development sector would be an advantage.




 


Key Areas of Executive Support


The Executive Assistant will support the Dean across:




Executive office and diary management


Correspondence and briefing preparation


Meetings, minutes and action tracking


Research and academic administration


Stakeholder and government liaison


Research partnerships and collaborative activities


Postgraduate and student research administration


Official travel and visitor coordination


Workshops, conferences and seminars


Records and confidential document management


Planning, reporting and governance support


General coordination of the Dean's Office

K30,495 – K37,276 per annum


Why Join PNGUNRE?


The Executive Assistant to the Dean will occupy an important coordination role within the Momis Ocean and Climate Research Institute as it develops its academic, research and external partnerships.


The position provides an opportunity to work directly with the Dean and interact with researchers, academics, government agencies and other partners involved in ocean, climate and environmental initiatives. Geotechnical Technician
 for our MTS Technical Department. Reporting to the Geotechnical Engineer the primary objective of this role is to install and maintain geotechnical monitoring systems and equipment in the field, perform tests, take samples, readings or measurements, enter data, and maintain records and/or data storage systems.
This role will be site based at the Hidden Valley Mine on FIFO for PNG Nationals only working on a 14/7 roster.
Key roles and responsibilities include:




Ensure Job Specific Safety Skills and Responsibilities are met.


Contribute to the implementation of the company Health and Safety system and site.


Initiate new orders for stock.


Complete stores records accurately to maintain correct stock records.


Ensure all field supplies are adequate, on hand and if need be order and purchase field consumables (in consultation with the Geotechnical Engineer).


Maintenance of company field equipment and vehicles.


Contribute to the communication of data to management.


Contribute to the preparation of geotechnical reports.


Contribute to the manipulation and storage of field data to maintain data integrity.


Complete the downloading of data from monitoring equipment to ensure the completion of regulatory and company monitoring programs.


Ensure geotechnical data collected are accurately recorded and continuously update on the digital database.


Assist in ensuring adequate spare parts are always available to maintain equipment.


Ensure monitoring equipment is functioning correctly at all times.


Assist in the installation and maintenance of monitoring equipment.


Communicate geotechnical concerns raised by stakeholders to management.


Contribute to the timely completion of geotechnical monitoring programs to meet regulatory and company requirements.


Contribute to the calibration of measurement instruments including field calibrations.


Arrange for delivery of samples to appropriate Laboratories.


Carrying, labelling, packaging and transporting samples.


Carry out field Geotechnical Engineering tests.


Sample for rock & soil testing for engineering purposes.


Perform RQD & recovery logs at drilling sites.


Carry out drilling supervision including SPT tests.


Provide progressive updates to the Geotechnical Engineer.


Daily monitoring and collection of geotechnical data.


Communicate geotechnical concerns raised by stakeholders to management.




Qualifications, Skills and Experience required:




Completion of Grade 12 school education and an appropriate technical school certificate or diploma.


Generally 2 to 5 years of practical working experience in mine geotechnical work or related extractive industry field.


Proven exposure to geotechnical core logging, rock/soil mapping techniques, and slope performance monitoring

Excellent written and oral communication skills.


Ability to work without minimum supervisor.

Fixed term contract up to 11 September 2028 (with possible extension)


Based in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea


Open to PNG national candidates only 




 


About Palladium


Palladium is a global leader in the design, development, and delivery of Positive Impact – the intentional creation of enduring social and economic value.  We work with governments, businesses, and investors to solve the world's most pressing challenges. With a team of more than 2,000 employees operating in 75-plus countries and a global network of over 35,000 experts, we help improve economies, societies, and, most importantly, people's lives.


 


About PNG-Australia Strongim Wok Long TVET (SWLT)


The PNG–Australia Strongim Wok Long Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) (SWLT) program is a four-year, AUD 80 million investment by the Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) to support Papua New Guinea’s (PNG) efforts to strengthen its TVET sector. Aligned with PNG’s national priority to build an educated and skilled workforce for resilient economic growth, SWLT aims to enhance the quality, relevance, and inclusiveness of skills development. The program supports improvements in national quality assurance systems, technical college standards, graduate employability, and Australia’s visible and trusted development partnership with PNG.


The program aligns with the broader goals of the 
Australia–PNG Development Partnership Plan 2024–2029
, which emphasises locally led development, education investment, and inclusive growth, as well as 
PNG’s Higher and Technical Education Reform Act 2020
.


 


This Opportunity


As 
Senior Project Coordinator
 you will be responsible for providing cross pillar support to manage the implementation and delivery of a range of SWLT activities under the direction of the senior leadership team and in-consultation with technical advisers and partners.


This will include: 




Support technical leads in engagement with Government of PNG counterparts, DFAT, technical partners and consultants to support activity design, consultation, and delivery.


Lead and support the preparation of Concept Notes, Terms of Reference, briefing papers, draft deliverables and other outputs from early scoping through drafting, review, approval, and completion.


Lead and maintain program trackers, delivery schedules, and workplans to support effective decision-making.


Identify delivery risks and bottlenecks across activities and proactively support mitigation actions with technical leads.


Monitor alignment between approved budgets, scopes of work, and delivery progress across multiple activities.


Support preparation and follow-up for steering committees, technical advisory groups, coordination forums, workshops, and consultations.


Work with the operations focal points including SWLT Procurement and Finance Managers on activity procurement processes including scoping, scheduling and documentation.


Assist the technical leads and Operations Senior Coordinator with managing consultants and partners, including contract milestones, deliverable tracking, and reporting requirements.


Contribute to monitoring and reporting against program outputs, priorities, and agreed indicators, including dashboard and tracker inputs as required.


Provide responsive, ad‑hoc program management and coordination support as priorities shift, new requests emerge, or activities are brought forward or deferred.


Understand and contribute to SWLT gender equality, disability and social inclusion (GEDSI) objectives as relevant to this role and participate in GEDSI learning and engagement as required.


Ensure adherence to DFAT and Palladium safeguarding standards and policies and commit to prevent harm, and commit to promoting safe, inclusive environments, including reporting concerns appropriately.


Contribute to office learning culture by seeking out knowledge, sharing fresh perspectives and ideas, and taking initiative in problem-solving.


Support SWLT to be climate friendly by thinking about and implementing ways to reduce waste and use environmental practices.


Understand and work in line with SWLT principles
[1]
 at all times.




 


About you


You will demonstrate proven experience in the following areas:




Strong program management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple, concurrent activities at different stages and with varying stakeholders


Proven ability to manage complex workplans and trackers that maintain oversight of activity performance


Demonstrated interpersonal skills to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders and act as a trusted coordination point across diverse audiences


Demonstrated understanding of MEL tools underpinning results monitoring frameworks


A practical understanding of procurement processes and financial management, including an ability to understand and analyse activity budgets


Capacity to support adaptive management, responding to shifting priorities and changes in direction


Strong skills in writing, reviewing, and being able to interpret and synthesise information readily


High level of organisation, initiative and self-management and the ability to work across priority tasks and adhoc requests while also working collaboratively with senior, technical staff and driving progress


Participation and positive engagement in diverse teams, supporting a results-driven culture of learning and inclusion


Demonstrated commitment to the principles of locally-led, socially inclusive, politically informed and adaptive programming.




 


To Apply


Please submit your application online, including your CV and brief cover letter, outlining your suitability in line with the requirements of the position through 
https://palladium.csod.com/ux/ats/careersite/2/home/requisition/25540?c=palladium


 


 


Closing date: 
Friday 25
th
 September 2026, 11.59pm AEST


 


Equity, Diversity & Inclusion -
 Palladium is committed to embedding equity, diversity and inclusion across all activities. We promote a diverse and inclusive workforce and ensure all applicants and employees are treated fairly and equally, regardless of background or personal characteristics. We encourage applications from all individuals and provide reasonable adjustments or accommodations where required.


 


Should you require any adjustments to be made due to a disability or you are a neurodivergent individual or for any other circumstance, please email our team at 
[email protected]
 and we will be in touch to discuss.

 Palladium maintains a zero-tolerance approach to all forms of harm, including sexual exploitation, abuse, harassment, child abuse, and human trafficking. We are committed to protecting our people, partners, and communities and ensuring safe and respectful environments. All personnel are expected to uphold safeguarding standards, with successful candidates subject to enhanced screening, including safeguarding-focused assessments and due diligence, in line with Palladium’s Code of Conduct and safeguarding policies.

28335.description:
(People who know surface preparation is what makes the finish last)


Location: Lae


Important:
 If you do not have at least five years of proven industrial painting or abrasive blasting experience, please do not submit your CV.


Atlas PNG, part of Kenmore Limited, operates in steel manufacturing, fabrication, construction and turnkey housing through Steel Haus and Framex. Our work depends on steel products and structures being prepared, coated and finished properly—not simply made to look good for handover.


We’re looking for experienced Industrial Painters and Sandblasters to join our Lae operation.


This is not an entry-level role or an opportunity to learn on the job. It is for people who already understand abrasive blasting, surface preparation, paint mixing and industrial coating standards.


What You’ll Be Doing


You’ll prepare steel surfaces for coating by cleaning, masking and abrasive blasting them to the required standard. You’ll safely set up, operate and maintain sandblasting and industrial painting equipment.


You’ll mix and apply coatings correctly, maintain the required micron thickness and check your work to ensure it meets the job specifications and quality standards.


When production is busy—and it will be—you’ll need to work efficiently without cutting corners. You’ll follow safety procedures, look after the equipment and report defects or problems before they affect the finished product.


The expectation is simple: every surface is prepared correctly, every coating is properly applied and every job meets the required standard.


Who This Suits


This suits someone with at least five years of hands-on industrial painting or sandblasting experience.


You understand surface preparation, abrasive blasting and industrial coating application. You know how to mix paint correctly and achieve consistent micron readings. A relevant trade certificate will be an advantage.


You’re physically fit, able to work under pressure and capable of following technical and safety instructions. You communicate clearly, work well with others and take responsibility for the quality of your work.


You don’t cover up poor preparation with another coat of paint. You do the job properly from the beginning.


Why You’ll Like Working Here


Atlas PNG works on practical steel manufacturing, fabrication and construction projects where the quality of the finished product matters.


You’ll be working in a hands-on environment with a team that understands production demands and expects professional standards.


If you know your trade, work safely and consistently deliver a quality finish, it won’t go unnoticed.


How to Apply


If you have the experience, technical ability and work ethic required, we want to hear from you.


Send your CV, a short application letter and copies of any relevant trade certificates to:

Joining our commercial team, the Team Lead – Contracts provides leadership and guidance to the Contracts team, ensuring high standards of contract administration, negotiation, and compliance. This role combines mentoring of team members with a strong technical focus, taking a lead role in procurement planning and market engagements under the direction of the Principal and Superintendent – Contracts. The position plays a pivotal role in achieving effective commercial outcomes, strengthening supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable legislation.

Provide day-to-day leadership, mentoring, and guidance to Contracts Officers, fostering capability development and professional growth.


Allocate tasks, set priorities, and oversee workload to ensure deadlines and quality standards are consistently met.


Conduct regular feedback, coaching, and performance development for team members.

Conduct audits and reviews of contract performance, ensuring adherence to obligations.


Foster and maintain strong relationships with vendors and service providers.


Act as a primary point of contact for contractual matters, facilitating communication and collaboration with external partners.


Collaborate with internal departments, including operations, supply and finance, to support contract-related initiatives.


Drive improvements in procurement and contract management processes, including development of templates, evaluation methods, and best practice approaches.


Capture and share lessons learned from market engagements to strengthen future strategies.


Stay abreast of industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging risks incorporating these into contract strategies.


Provide training and guidance to internal teams on contract management processes and best practices.

Degree Qualified tertiary qualifications in a relevant field (business or legal etc) essential.


Procurement or contract management certification (e.g., CIPS, WCC, or equivalent) desirable.


5 – 8 years’ relevant work experience in a Commercial Contracts role, preferably in mining or similar environment.


Demonstrated knowledge of contract administration, negotiation, and management.


Strong experience in leading tenders, supplier evaluations, and market engagements.


Demonstrated behaviours consistent with K92 Mining core values.


Demonstrated problem solving and decision-making capability.


Strong commercial analysis and evaluation capabilities.


Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop team members with diverse skills and backgrounds.


Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly to, and influence, internal and external stakeholders.


Experience communicating with vendors in PNG and internationally.

28598.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited operates the Kainantu Gold Mine in the Eastern Highlands Province. Since we launched in 2016, we've grown gold production every year, boosting Papua New Guinea's economy. We take pride in supporting your communities, with nearly 94% of our team members being fellow PNG locals.


Looking ahead, we will significantly increase our gold production in the next three years. This expansion means that K92 is a place for building a stable career, contributing to the community, and being a key part of our success.


About the role


 


Gold room Operators are skilled technicians responsible for the day-to-day operation of the gold room and gravity recovery circuits including the;
• Gravity recovery processes including Falcon Concentrator and shaking tables
• Calcining and smelting of concentrate to dore
• Maintaining the highest levels of product security and accurate record keeping.
• Operational management of the tails storage facility and return water.


Key / Major Accountabilities


Key accountabilities of this position include.


• Perform the day-to-day operation of the gold room and TSF including;
o Gravity recovery circuit comprising scalping screen, Falcon concentrator, shaking tables
o Calcining and smelting of concentrate to dore
o Preparation of required reagents
o Management of tailings deposition and plant return water systems
o Management of off-site water discharges from the TSF
o Dore shipment


 


About You 


To be considered for this role, you must have a minimum of Grade 10 school Certificate with good personal attributes, and 3 years’ experience in gold room operation. In addition to this you will have some or all the following.


• Valid PNG Class 3 license (essential)
• Machinery license's including loader, skid steer, telehandler (desirable)
• Previous experience in a process plant (desirable).
• An appropriate trades trade certificate (desirable)
• You must be physically fit
• to enjoy practical and manual activities
• to be able to read and follow written instructions in English.
• the ability to work as part of a team.
• good hand-eye co-ordination


 


Life at K92  


Our core values — Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Safety — are central to our operations and fundamental to our success. K92 upholds a commitment to equal opportunity, striving to ensure that every individual can reach their highest potential without experiencing discrimination.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


We believe in sharing our success with our employees. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer participation in long- and short-term incentive plans. We also offer savings programs, medical assistance, as well as access to our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


If you share our values and are looking for your next career step, come join us on this exciting journey. Submit your application through our website today.


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP

28548.description:
Goodman Fielder Papua New Guinea is one of PNG’s largest food companies, manufacturing and distributing high-quality Flour, Stock Feed, Snacks and Bakery products throughout the country. The company owns a host of iconic brands which include; Flame Flour, Flame Stockfeed, Bilas Bread, Arthur's Pie, Twisties, Skel Rice and the Meadow Lea range.


At GFI, we care about making everyday food better for everyone.


Our goal is to be the leading and most innovative local food company with a mission to meet our customers’ needs for superior quality foods with brands that are trusted by families everywhere.  We are the go-to source of consumer, shopper, and customer insights to help our customer and business partners succeed.


We currently have an immediate vacancy for an 
Administrative Officer
 who will be responsible for providing administrative and clerical support to ensure the efficient operation of the administrative function in our Administration Department in 
Lae
. The role involves managing documentation, coordinating communications, maintaining records, assisting with staff accommodation and travel arrangements, and supporting day-to-day operational activities.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


Administration Support




Provide general administrative and clerical support to the department.


Prepare, draft, and distribute correspondence, reports, memos, and presentations.


Maintain and update filing systems, records, and databases.


Ensure all documents are properly filed and archived.




 


Office Coordination




Coordinate meetings, appointments, and departmental schedules.


Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, and follow-up action items.


Manage office supplies and ensure adequate stock levels.


Coordinate courier services and mail distribution.




 


Records and Documentation




Maintain employee, vendor, property, and operational records.


Update trackers, registers, and reports accurately and on time.


Ensure documents comply with company policies and procedures.


Assist in preparing monthly reports and summaries.




 


Accommodation and Travel Support




Assist with staff accommodation arrangements and room allocations.


Coordinate hotel bookings, transportation, and travel itineraries.


Maintain accommodation and occupancy records.


Support expatriate and national staff movement requirements.




 


Procurement and Vendor Coordination




Request quotations from vendors and suppliers.


Process purchase requests and monitor procurement status.


Follow up on deliveries, invoices, and payment documentation.


Maintain supplier contact information and records.




 


Communication and Customer Service




Serve as a point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.


Respond to inquiries and provide administrative assistance.


Liaise with departments regarding operational and administrative matters.


Always ensure professional communication.




 


Compliance and Reporting




Ensure administrative processes comply with company requirements.


Assist with audits and document reviews when required.


Generate regular reports and maintain accurate records.


Support implementation of company procedures and policies.




 


 


KEY COMPETENCIES/ EXPERIENCE:


 


Skills and Competencies




Strong organizational and administrative skills.


Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


Attention to detail and accuracy.


Time management and multitasking abilities.


Ability to maintain confidentiality.


Strong problem-solving and coordination skills.


Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Customer service oriented with a professional attitude.




 


Experience / Qualifications Required




Diploma or Certificate in Business Administration, Office Management, or a related field.


Previous experience in an administrative or office support role is preferred.


Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).




      Experience with document management systems is an advantage


 


Be part of the Skel life and join a team that values healthy eating and active lifestyles and wants to share that with all the people of PNG. Email your EOI and CV/Resume in 1 PDF file and send to email : 
[email protected]
.


In the subject line address as 
"Administrative Officer".


Applications close 
Thursday 24th September 2026.


Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.


 


 








Apply

28545.description:
We are seeking to recruit for the position of 
Nurse
 for our 
Safety, Health, Security & Risk – Medical
 Department. Reporting to the Senior Nurse, the successful applicant will mainly be responsible for assisting with providing professional, confidential and quality nursing and health care service to all clients to maximise employee well-being, health and physical fitness.


 


Key roles and responsibilities include:




Deliver primary healthcare, occupational health services and emergency response support to employees and contractors.


Conduct clinical assessments, health surveillance activities and fitness-for-work medicals.


Maintain accurate and confidential patient records and medical documentation.


Support emergency response, trauma management, triage and medical evacuations.


Promote workforce health and wellbeing through education, preventative health and public health initiatives.


Manage pharmaceuticals, medical consumables, clinical equipment and inventory levels.


Participate in health surveillance, community health and workplace wellbeing programmes.


Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary medical team while maintaining professional and clinical standards




Qualifications, Skills and Experience required:




Current registration and licence to practise as a Registered Nurse with the PNG Nursing Council 
(Mandatory)


Minimum three (3) years' post-registration clinical nursing experience 
(Mandatory)


Fluent in Tok Pisin and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with a diverse workforce 
(Mandatory)


Experience in emergency response, triage and acute patient care 
(Mandatory)


Ability to work independently in a remote and multidisciplinary environment 
(Mandatory)


Strong clinical assessment, patient management and medical record documentation skills 
(Mandatory)


Experience in occupational health, mining, resources or remote-site healthcare 
(Desirable)


Experience using electronic medical record and occupational health management systems 
(Desirable)


Current Advanced Life Support (ALS) / Basic Life Support (BLS) certification 
(Desirable)


Drug and alcohol testing certification 
(Desirable)


PNG Class 6 Driving Licence 
(Desirable)




 


The above role is Hidden Valley Mine site based
